name: Holiday Charcuterie Grazing Plate — Aged White Cheddar, Gruyère, Prosciutto & Water Crackers
whyItWorks: Lets you graze safely at holiday parties by picking aged cheeses (2-year White Cheddar, Gruyère, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Gouda—all naturally lactose-safe), paper-thin prosciutto or turkey breast, and plain water or Ritz crackers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Build your plate from the aged hard cheeses, thin prosciutto or deli turkey, and plain refined-wheat crackers—skip whole nuts, dried apricots/cranberries, seeded crackers, and peppercorn salami.
watchOuts: Avoid raw crudité veggies, whole almonds/pistachios, seeded multigrain crackers, olives, and spicy calabrese salami
